text: Ingests distributed traces and APM data from instrumented applications
quote: Send Traces and APM Data

text: Provides a flamegraph/trace view showing every span, duration, and parent-child relationships across services
quote: Follow a single request across all microservices with a flamegraph view that shows every span, its duration, and parent-child relationships.

text: Search and filter traces by service, operation, duration, or any span attribute
quote: Search and filter traces by service, operation, duration, or any span attribute.

text: Visualizes a service map showing dependencies and highlighting endpoints with failed calls
quote: Visualize dependencies between services, databases, and messaging systems, and spot which endpoint is receiving failed calls, sized by incoming call rate.

text: Analyzes request flow through a sequence of services to find drop-off points (funnel analysis)
quote: Analyze how requests flow through a sequence of services or spans and identify drop-off points.

text: Collects logs from files, stdout, FluentBit/FluentD/Logstash, OTel SDKs, HTTP endpoints, and cloud services
quote: Collect logs from files, stdout, FluentBit/FluentD/Logstash, OpenTelemetry SDKs, HTTP endpoints, and cloud services.

text: Search, filter, and analyze logs with List/Time-Series/Table views plus live log streaming
quote: Search, filter, and analyze logs with List, Time Series, and Table views. Stream live logs in real time.

text: Parses, transforms, and enriches logs before storage via a functional pipeline builder
quote: Parse, transform, and enrich logs before storage using SigNoz's functional pipeline builder.

text: Set up alerts on log patterns, counts, or attribute values
quote: Set up alerts on log patterns, counts, or attribute values.

text: Collects metrics from apps, infrastructure, and Prometheus, and auto-derives APM metrics from traces
quote: Collect metrics from applications, infrastructure, and existing Prometheus setups. SigNoz also derives APM metrics from traces automatically.

text: Metrics Explorer lets you query/visualize data via a visual builder, PromQL, or ClickHouse SQL
quote: Use the Metrics Explorer to query and visualize data with a visual builder or advanced query languages like PromQL and ClickHouse SQL.

text: Dashboard panel editor supports seven panel types with live preview, switchable without losing formatting
quote: Build panels in a dedicated editor: seven panel types with a live preview, switchable mid-edit without losing your formatting, units or thresholds.

text: Dashboards support dynamic, query, custom, and textbox template variables
quote: Filter everything with variables: dynamic, query, custom and textbox variables.

text: From any dashboard panel you can drill into underlying logs/traces, break out by attribute, seed an alert, or export as PNG/SVG/CSV
quote: Drill down from any panel: jump into the underlying logs and traces, break out by an attribute, create an alert seeded from the panel, or download it as PNG, SVG or CSV.

text: Dashboards can be published publicly via a shareable URL accessible without login
quote: Publish a dashboard publicly: a separate flow that generates a public URL anyone can open without logging in.

text: Dashboards can be managed as code
quote: Manage dashboards as code

text: Dashboards can be edited directly as JSON in-app without using the API
quote: Edit a dashboard as JSON: read, copy, download or hand-edit the whole spec in the app, without going through the API.

text: Provides a complete guide for migrating metrics, traces/APM, logs, dashboards, and alerts from Datadog
quote: Complete guide to migrating from Datadog to SigNoz. How to migrate metrics, traces/APM, logs, dashboards, and alerts.

text: Migration from another platform can be done incrementally, one signal type at a time, running both platforms in parallel
quote: The process can be done incrementally—you can migrate one signal type at a time while running both platforms in parallel.

text: Offers a Datadog Receiver as a bridge solution for ingesting Datadog-format telemetry
quote: Bridge Solution: Datadog Receiver

text: Role-based access control where roles group transactions/permissions assigned to principals
quote: Roles are the core unit of access control in SigNoz. A role groups transactions together — when a principal is assigned a role, they receive all the transactions that role contains.

text: Service accounts provide scoped, credential-free programmatic API access for CI/CD, automation, and integrations
quote: Service accounts provide a secure way to grant programmatic API access to SigNoz without tying credentials to individual users. Use them for CI/CD pipelines, automation scripts, external integrations

text: Captures gen_ai.* spans and metrics from applications via standard OpenTelemetry and stores them alongside other telemetry
quote: Your application emits gen_ai.* spans and metrics through standard OpenTelemetry libraries, exports them over OTLP, and SigNoz stores and queries them next to the rest of your application telemetry.

text: Publishes Agent Skills that teach AI coding assistants to search docs, generate telemetry queries, write ClickHouse queries, and manage dashboards/alerts
quote: SigNoz publishes Agent Skills that teach AI coding assistants to work with SigNoz: search the docs, generate queries over traces, logs, and metrics, write ClickHouse queries, create and modify dashboards, manage alerts and saved Explorer vi

text: Connects AI agents (Claude, Cursor, Copilot, etc.) via MCP for natural-language access to metrics, logs, traces, and alerts
quote: Connect Claude, Cursor, Copilot, and other AI agents to SigNoz via MCP for natural language access to metrics, logs, traces, and alerts.

text: Supports investigating what changed after a deploy to correlate regressions with releases
quote: Investigate What Changed After a Deploy

text: Provides guidance/workflow for tuning noisy alerts
quote: Tune a Noisy Alert

text: Supports creating dashboards from natural-language input
quote: Dashboard Creation from Natural Language

text: Free open-source, self-hostable SigNoz deployable via Docker, Kubernetes, or Linux with full data control
quote: Free open-source SigNoz that runs in your own infrastructure. Deploy with Docker, Kubernetes, or Linux and keep full control of your data plane.

text: Monitors service latency, error rate, throughput, Apdex, top endpoints, and database/external call performance
quote: Monitor service latency, error rate, throughput, Apdex, top endpoints, database calls, and external calls.
